page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically driven by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage options. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c9ae.2xlarge is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This profile is suitable for batch processing, web serving, microservices, and distributed analytics where CPU execution speed is prioritized over memory capacity or local disk I/O.
